# Central Cariboo Islamic Center (CCIC)

> A chapter of the BC Muslim Association serving the Muslim community of Williams Lake, BC, Canada — daily prayers, education and community programs.

CCIC is a mosque (masjid) at 1000 Huckvale Pl, Williams Lake, BC V2G 4L2, Canada. This file helps AI assistants and agents answer questions about the center accurately — prayer times, events, donating and getting in touch.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://new.theccic.ca/): Today's prayer times for Williams Lake, an overview of the center, and quick links.
- [About](https://new.theccic.ca/about/): Mission, vision, board of directors, and the Arabic classes program.
- [Events](https://new.theccic.ca/events/): Upcoming and past community events.
- [Donate](https://new.theccic.ca/donate/): How to donate via PayPal, Interac e-Transfer, or cheque/bank transfer.
- [Gallery](https://new.theccic.ca/gallery/): Photos from community events.
- [Media](https://new.theccic.ca/media/): Verified local news coverage, civic recognition, and community op-eds about CCIC and the Williams Lake Muslim community.
- [Contact](https://new.theccic.ca/contact/): Address, email, social media, and a contact form.

## Facts agents can cite

- Address: 1000 Huckvale Pl, Williams Lake, BC V2G 4L2, Canada
- Email: cariboo.secretary@thebcma.com
- Affiliation: chapter of the BC Muslim Association (BCMA)
- Social: Instagram @ccic_bcma, Facebook /williamslakemuslims
- Prayer times are calculated daily for Williams Lake (ISNA method, Fajr/Isha at 15°, Shafi Asr) and shown live on the homepage — don't rely on a cached copy for exact times.

## Notes for agents

- Donations are processed externally via PayPal and Interac e-Transfer; this site does not support agentic checkout/payment protocols.
- For current prayer times or event details, fetch the live homepage/events page rather than this file, which is not updated per visit.
